subject: Extract shared InputDialog to eliminate code duplication
body:
Extract shared InputDialog to eliminate code duplication

Move duplicated PromptInput method from SftpBrowserPanel and
SftpBrowserWindow into a shared InputDialog.Prompt utility class.
Eliminates the only code duplication flagged by SonarCloud.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

triage.rationale: SftpBrowserPanel and SFTPBrowserWindow do not exist in our fork; we do not have an embedded SFTP browser.
